items.meaning: If you do something regularly, you become very good at it.
items.example: I play the guitar every day: practice makes perfect.
items.fr: C'est en forgeant qu'on devient forgeron.

items.meaning: It is better to do something late than not to do it at all.
items.example: He finally replied to my email. Better late than never!

items.en: Rome wasn't built in a day.
items.meaning: Important things take time and patience.
items.example: Learning English takes time. Rome wasn't built in a day.
items.fr: Paris ne s'est pas fait en un jour.
